subtitle: Lesson 12 · Designing around a deadline, not a threshold

code:
Record: Case (Priority="Urgent", open)
SLA Target: 4 hours from CreatedDate
T-1 hour  -> Notify Owner: "1 hr left"
T+0, still open:
  Notify Manager: "SLA breached"
  Update: Escalated__c = true
  Email Contact: escalation notice
caption: Two scheduled actions off one trigger, not one action firing twice.
